name: camayoc_execution_path_for_mechanism
description: verification-and-liveness Q11: which artifact actually runs for a mechanism, from where, refreshed by what, and when it was last refreshed.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?path ?label ?executesArtifact ?repositorySource ?refreshedBy ?lastRefreshedAt WHERE { BIND(<{mechanism}> AS ?path) ?path a aegis:ExecutionPath ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:executesArtifact ?executesArtifact ; aegis:repositorySource ?repositorySource ; aegis:refreshedBy ?refreshedBy . OPTIONAL { ?path aegis:lastRefreshedAt ?lastRefreshedAt } }
